<h1 align="center">
    Terraform DigitalOcean NFS shares with attachment and snapshot support  


</h1>

<p align="center" style="font-size: 1.2rem;">

## Prerequisites

This module has a few dependencies: 
- [Terraform 1.5.4](https://learn.hashicorp.com/terraform/getting-started/install.html)


**IMPORTANT:** Since the `master` branch used in `source` varies based on new modifications, we suggest that you use the release versions [here](https://github.com/https://github.com/terraform-do-modules/terraform-digitalocean-nfs/releases).


Here are examples of how you can use this module in your inventory structure:
### custom-certificate
```hcl
   module "nfs" {
  source = "../../"
  name        = "app"
  environment = "dev"
  enabled     = true

  region           = "nyc1"
  size             = 50
  vpc_id           = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  performance_tier = "high"
  enable_attachment = false
  attachment_vpc_id = ""
  enable_snapshot   = false
}

```

## Inputs

| Name              | Description                                                                          | Type     | Default  | Required |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | -------- | :------: |
| name              | The name used to create and identify the DigitalOcean NFS resource.                  | `string` | `null`   |    no    |
| environment       | The environment name, such as dev, staging, or production.                           | `string` | `null`   |    no    |
| enabled           | Controls whether the DigitalOcean NFS resources should be created.                   | `bool`   | `true`   |    no    |
| region            | The DigitalOcean region where the NFS resource will be created.                      | `string` | `null`   |    no    |
| size              | The size of the DigitalOcean NFS share in GiB.                                       | `number` | `50`     |    no    |
| vpc_id            | The ID of the VPC where the DigitalOcean NFS resource will be provisioned.           | `string` | `null`   |    no    |
| performance_tier  | The performance tier to use for the DigitalOcean NFS share.                          | `string` | `"high"` |    no    |
| enable_attachment | Controls whether the DigitalOcean NFS share should be attached to a VPC.             | `bool`   | `false`  |    no    |
| attachment_vpc_id | The VPC ID used for attaching the DigitalOcean NFS share when attachment is enabled. | `string` | `""`     |    no    |
| enable_snapshot   | Controls whether a snapshot of the DigitalOcean NFS share should be created.         | `bool`   | `false`  |    no    |


## Outputs

| Name                 | Description                                                     |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| nfs_id               | The ID of the DigitalOcean NFS share.                           |
| nfs_host             | The hostname or endpoint of the DigitalOcean NFS share.         |
| nfs_mount_path       | The mount path of the DigitalOcean NFS share.                   |
| nfs_status           | The current status of the DigitalOcean NFS share.               |
| nfs_performance_tier | The performance tier configured for the DigitalOcean NFS share. |
| snapshot_id          | The ID of the snapshot created for the DigitalOcean NFS share.  |
| attachment_id        | The ID of the DigitalOcean NFS attachment.                      |
